hero.title: Websites, apps and video that work for your business
hero.subtitle: I combine code with creative work. I design and build websites and web apps, and I shoot and edit video — one person from idea to launch.

services.title: How I can
services.text: Two areas, one person. Video that grabs attention and a website that turns it into customers.

video.title: Video production
video.text: Ads, reels and social media content — from script to final file.

web.title: Websites and apps
web.text: Fast, responsive websites and apps that support your sales and your team's work.

work.title: Selected
work.text: A few projects I'm proud of — each with a short story of how it was made.

process.title: How I
process.text: A simple process with no surprises — you always know what's happening.

talk.title: Discovery call
talk.text: I learn about your business, goals and style. We agree on the scope and who prepares the content and materials.

concept.title: Concept and quote
concept.text: I prepare a visual design and functional outline we can still adjust. Along with it you get a fixed quote.

build.title: Build
build.text: Once the design is approved, I get to work. I stay available throughout, and for larger projects we review progress together.

review.title: Presentation and revisions
review.text: I present the finished result and gather your feedback. Small fixes are made right away.

support.title: Support
support.text: I help with hosting, SEO and questions after launch. Our collaboration doesn't end at handover.

testimonials.title: What clients
testimonials.text: Feedback from people and companies I've worked with.

recruiter.title: Looking for a
recruiter.text: A full-stack developer working with React and Django who also understands product and marketing. My profile page covers my stack, certificates and projects with code.

cta.title: Have a project?
cta.text: Tell me briefly what you need — I'll reply with suggested next steps.

meta.title: Jacek Kozłowski – Full Stack Developer & Video Creator
meta.description: Websites and web apps in React and Python, plus video creation: filming, editing, graphics and animation. One person from idea to launch.

feedback.text1: Full professionalism, but with a relaxed vibe – just the way I like it. The website works great, looks awesome, and the whole process was stress-free. Highly recommend!
feedback.text2: I had the opportunity to work with Jacek several times over the past year and watched with appreciation how much effort he puts into learning and how much progress he has made. He went from creating a simple Python script that generates PDFs from HTML to building a full application in React with a Django backend. He’s able to find solutions on his own, learns quickly, and isn’t afraid of challenges. As an IT team leader, I’m convinced that with this mindset, he will quickly become a valuable member of any team.
feedback.text3: Working with Jacek was absolutely smooth and professional from start to finish. The website he created for me exceeded my expectations – it's modern, clear, responsive, and perfectly reflects the character of my brand. I was especially impressed by his personalized approach, quick communication, and great understanding of my needs. Every adjustment was implemented instantly, and the entire process went efficiently and in a friendly atmosphere. I wholeheartedly recommend working with Jacek Kozłowski to anyone looking for a reliable and creative web designer. It’s an investment that truly pays off!
feedback.text4: Awesome collaboration! The concept, execution, and attitude were 100%. Thanks for handling everything – I didn’t have to worry about a thing.
feedback.text5: Ambitious and highly dedicated, which is clearly reflected in the projects he completes. I'm very satisfied with the results and will definitely come back again. Highly recommended! 😊
